scope: Independent portable, native managed inline cell-editor, consumer, UI/spec and core-qualifier source review. Selected input certification is distinct from final producer qualifications, actual Cocoa and broad dependency closure.
assessment: Portable source/value stamps, last admitted edited-cell version and opaque session/request clocks refuse stale/ABA/candidate admission before a single source+draft publication. Draft recovery APIs do not require healthy source metadata. Exact historical red tests are retained; added candidate CAS, drift, exhaustion and detached-string tests are meaningful.

Private TextField session identity is independent of visible-cell pools. Native accepted bytes import only at originating event/barrier under exact client/shadow epoch/session and owner+lifetime guards; compatibility Change does not read widget state from peer-window owner callbacks.

View-only hide/conflict retains already admitted same-session native records for seal/ack. Immutable Cocoa rules refuse fresh mutation, while exact old-client unmark/cancel may retire. Owner replacement, Cancel/rebegin and retired bindings invalidate old shadows. Status-derived disabled bypass is confined to accepted private records after parent/modal/tab/lifetime eligibility.

Visible writable private editor replaces the host Tab stop; hidden/nonready state restores host focusability without reappearance focus theft. Private composition cancels before whole draft Escape. Tab/focus loss preserve drafts without source commit.

Settlement reserves one originating-window request; deletes it before callback, checks context/client retirement, seals manual preedit by explicit FIFO Step and suppresses whole-application-close user dispatch. Production uses bounded existing main dispatch; no owner/main synchronous wait is added.

Theme correction applies the current TextField style before mandatory cell geometry, refreshes retained theme, preserves widget/client/session/draft and verifies current foreground/background/type size plus exact cell exterior at fractional DPI. Current header/row labels update private AX context.

Native measurement Editor pointer and cell/header slices are copied for caller inspection. Source/model reads stay on owner outside Render/Position; native pane geometry/input and AX cached text paths preserve originating lock constraints.

Consumer immutable COW candidate admission precedes domain pointer publication. Toolbar Save waits originating settlement, then reads latest acknowledged draft; operation token/session guards prevent stale cancellation/ack from overwriting a new operation.

Core qualifier uses exclusive output marker/log/proof creation and existing owned child-group timeout cleanup. Every check has argv, exit, elapsed, raw log SHA, before/current selected source map and result requiring all checks plus no drift. Current core-v3 maps all 91 selected inputs and three exit-zero raw logs exactly.
